items.quote: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
items.claim: Abraham agreed to Ephron's price and paid him four hundred shekels of silver by weight, the price Ephron had named publicly in front of the sons of Heth.
items.action: weighed out payment of silver to
items.mechanism: a purchase agreed in public before witnesses and paid in weighed silver

items.quote: four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant
items.claim: The text treats weighed silver, measured in shekels, as a standard medium of exchange that merchants accepted.
items.mechanism: payment by weighing metal rather than counting coins
